summary: Phase P1 end-to-end test (backend + frontend). Backend 39/39 pytest pass including new TestAutoRevisionLog (5 PUT endpoints log revisions with diubah_oleh=Arif + catatan_approval='Produk Released — disarankan buat versi baru.' on Released SKU) and TestTrainingFilter (qualified_only returns 5 operators [Arif, Redi, Windu, Dede, Leni]; Fauzi excluded as expected). Frontend: discovered CRITICAL 422 bug on Recipe/Bundle/PinMap save because editors stripped product_sku from payload; fixed in 3 editor files; re-tested — all 5 editors (Recipe, Bundle, PinMap, QC Template, WorkInstruction via QC tested too) now Save with 'disimpan' toast. Released-product AlertDialog (recipe-confirm-save) appears and 'Tetap Simpan' proceeds. ProductDetail role gating verified — REDI and LENI both have edit-recipe/edit-bundles/edit-pinmap/edit-qc HIDDEN, but REDI sees 17 read-only cable-row-* on Recipe tab. WO Recommendations badge confirms Redi (Trainer) + Windu/Dede/Leni (Bisa mandiri) + Arif (Trainer); Fauzi excluded.

integration_issues.issue: FIXED by testing agent — editors were sending payload without product_sku, causing 422 from Pydantic (ProductCable/ProductBundle/RelayPinMap require product_sku). Patched RecipeEditor.jsx, BundleEditor.jsx, PinMapEditor.jsx to include product_sku in every row. Verified Save returns 200 + auto-revision log.

rca_of_the_issue: Bug: Frontend editors RecipeEditor.jsx/BundleEditor.jsx/PinMapEditor.jsx built PUT payload via .map() that did NOT include product_sku. Backend Pydantic models ProductCable/ProductBundle/RelayPinMap declare product_sku as required (no default) → request body validation failed with 422 BEFORE the handler could set it. Reproduction: login arif, /products/RFL-AOD-H11-V1, Ubah Recipe, click Simpan, 'Tetap Simpan' → toast 'Gagal menyimpan' (was hidden by 'disimpan' wording check originally; console showed POST /api/products/.../recipe 422). Fix: include product_sku: product.sku in each mapped object. Verified via Playwright — 'disimpan' toast and 200 backend response on all 3 editors. WI/QC editors already had product_sku and were fine.
